title: FFI surface for Kotlin and Swift
summary: Completed owned UniFFI adapters, runtime numbering packaging, real Swift/Kotlin host tests and isolated memory/startup measurements.
description:
COMPLETED by P005(F002)/T018. The owned UniFFI boundary is implemented in core/src/ffi.rs:27, using the existing evaluator, expander, explanation and geocoder rather than another filtering implementation. It exports normalization, evaluation, flat place/language results including NotGeographic, geographic checks, prepared rules/conflict pairs, place-to-all-prefix access, structured explanation and dataset/content-format versions. Existing Decision variants remain public; no new Silence/Label filtering behavior was invented.

Snapshot and PreparedRules (ffi.rs:244/:309) are immutable Send+Sync handles. Place-derived rules retain exact Arc snapshot identity and reject different snapshots during explain/expand, even with identical version labels. Direct rules remain reusable. All input datasets validate before publication; failed replacement leaves old handles intact. No Rust lock spans a foreign callback.

Expansion (ffi.rs:556) uses synchronous bounded callbacks over existing iterators. It preflights deny streams and counts merged/deduplicated/allow-subtracted output before delivery; TooBroad/NotExpandable emits nothing. Results include rule IDs, typed reasons and exact-versus-ceiling counts. max_candidates applies per deny; preflight repeats walks and is not cancellable. Cancellation and declared/unexpected foreign errors stop at batch boundaries. Shells must run off the UI thread, stage output until success and release consumed batches.

Runtime numbering packaging: core/src/number_metadata.rs:38/:55/:95 implements CFNM v1 postcard framing, complete consumption and dependency-precondition validation. datasets/src/bin/build-number-metadata.rs:11 converts XML at build time only. The dependency DTO is pinned and tools/ffi-tests/numbering-v1.hex guards nonempty compatibility. core/src/dataset.rs rejects duplicate groups, trailing bytes and impossible counts without an unmeasured cap. Loading is eager, not lazy; content versions may be newer than the engine.

VERIFIED: 175 nonignored workspace tests, fmt, all-target/all-feature clippy -D warnings, doc tests, source/data checks and diff check pass. tools/test-ffi.sh generates fresh ignored bindings and executes real Swift and Kotlin/JNA host programs covering loading, normalization/geocoding/fallback, unsigned rule IDs/conflicts, explanation, snapshot mismatch, merged cap, allow subtraction, batches, cancellation, expected/unexpected callback errors, reentry and concurrent evaluation. Host fixtures and isolated release measurement ran separately; existing ignored distribution/real-data suites were not rerun.

MEASURED on macOS arm64: payload 526,596 bytes; isolated cold runtime parse 112.18 ms, Rust-heap peak 4,153,627 bytes, retained DB 1,863,810; old/new coexistence peak 6,017,437. Warm streaming 1,000 versus 10,000 numbers at batch 32 peaks at 887 versus 888 bytes; collecting peaks at 197,576. Durable commands/contracts/evidence: tools/ffi-tests/README.md and T018 completion summary.

REMAINING: P007 owns OTA delivery; production app integration and real-device extension budgets remain unverified. Measurements exclude RSS, foreign heaps and place datasets. The inherited compiled country enum still limits brand-new geographic region IDs; existing-region updates work and unknown shared-code IDs fail safely. No expander rewrite or country allowlist was introduced. Non-failing warnings remain for Cargo release multi-crate-type output collisions and two generated Kotlin unused expressions. Source/planner changes are uncommitted; no git mutation was authorized.

POST-COMPLETION AUDIT — UNRESOLVED ORIGINAL R2 REQUIREMENT: core/src/rule.rs:203 Pattern::parse only validates syntax. core/src/ffi.rs:399 matcher_from_input passes exact/prefix/suffix/pattern strings through Digits::parse/Pattern::parse without numbering-plan validation; prepare_rules_for_snapshot does not interpret a national partial number using country context. Matching uses international digits. With IT supplied, 0852296xxxx needs +390852296xxxx semantics while preserving its authored form; this conversion is absent. Complete-number validation in core/src/normalize.rs:81 uses the existing phonenumber::parse_with/is_valid_with path, but rule construction can bypass it. The phonenumber 0.3.10+9.0.33 dependency checks numbering-plan validity, not whether a number is assigned or active, and does not provide our wildcard-filter semantics. Existing host verification covers internal operations, not this complete user-input path. National-pattern preparation and consistently enforced rule validation remain core gaps requiring approved follow-up, never filtering logic delegated to platform shells. No source edits or task reopen performed. The three global decisions about worldwide use, future-country library releases and fundamental partial filtering are now owned by project Accepted Decisions; technical findings are preserved here.

acceptedDecisions.title: Include runtime numbering-data packaging in the FFI phase
acceptedDecisions.decision: P005/T018 includes the missing runtime-loadable numbering metadata packaging alongside UniFFI adapters, memory/startup checks and tests through generated Swift and Kotlin bindings.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: The current core operations require numbering metadata, but repository packaging currently covers place data only. Exposing a bundled-only database would not meet the runtime-data requirement. The user explicitly approved including this prerequisite in P005.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: Convert upstream XML at build time only and validate a versioned binary payload before making a runtime snapshot available. Preserve existing core APIs. Measure initialization and memory costs; do not claim lazy loading or device-budget compliance from host tests. P007 still owns OTA delivery. Present exact source/config/test files for approval before edits. Do not use Graphify.

acceptedDecisions.title: Use immutable FFI snapshots and bounded synchronous callbacks
acceptedDecisions.decision: Expose existing Rust behavior through owned UniFFI adapters and fully validated immutable dataset snapshots. Stream expansion through synchronous bounded callbacks using the existing iterator rather than rewriting it into an owned cursor. Verify generated Swift and Kotlin bindings with a host harness.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: The user approved the exact implementation scope. Callbacks keep the borrowed iterator alive within one Rust call, avoiding self-referential state and unnecessary changes to the proven expander.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: Implement in core/src/ffi.rs and number_metadata.rs, associated approved tests and packaging binary, and tools/test-ffi.sh plus tools/ffi-tests/. Preserve public APIs, keep all filtering in Rust, validate batch size and propagate cancellation/errors. No callback under a Rust lock. No generated bindings committed. Measure eager loading memory/startup; host checks do not prove device budgets. Parent reviews Luna implementation before completion.

tasks.title: Expose the shared core through UniFFI and verify Kotlin/Swift bindings
tasks.description:
Implement P005(F002)'s FFI boundary after inspecting the completed Rust core from P002–P004. The phase has no existing tasks. First inspect T004–T017 completion evidence and the repository to establish current file:line references, public structs, evaluator, streaming expansion, geocoder, dataset loading and version access. Existing core ownership stays in those phases; this task owns adapters and boundary tests, not a second filtering implementation. Design normalize/evaluate/geocode/expand/explain and dataset-version access through UniFFI against actual APIs rather than stale phase sketches. Keep expansion incremental across FFI (never a full materialized list), define thread safety and typed errors, preserve atomic dataset snapshots and runtime-loaded country data. Generate bindings during builds, never commit generated output. Present exact files and proposed changes for user approval before code edits, and record agreed architectural decisions on F002 and P005. Verify Rust adapters plus generated Kotlin and Swift bindings; document unavailable toolchains and unverified runtime behavior honestly. Add concrete code references after read-only inspection.

---
**Completion summary:**
Delivered P005(F002)'s owned UniFFI boundary and runtime numbering-data prerequisite. Parent rejected the initial delegated implementation, reproduced its merged-cap and panic defects, then completed and independently verified the fixes within the approved files. No commits, pushes, app UI changes, generated-binding commits, or expander rewrites.

Implementation: core/src/ffi.rs:27 defines structured errors/reasons; :244/:309 immutable Send+Sync Snapshot and PreparedRules handles; :356 resolves place rules to all prefixes and retains exact Arc snapshot identity; :419 guards absent runtime hint regions and ignores hints for international inputs; :489 exposes structured explanation/caveats; :556 streams synchronous bounded callbacks over existing iterators. Whole merged output is counted before callbacks, after deduplication/allow subtraction. TooBroad distinguishes exact merged counts from per-rule candidate ceilings and carries implicated IDs. Invalid sizes, duplicate IDs, mismatched snapshots, declared callback failures and unexpected foreign exceptions are typed; reentry holds no Rust lock. Direct rules remain snapshot-portable. Existing public core functions/types and core algorithms are preserved.

core/src/number_metadata.rs:38/:55/:95 implements CFNM v1 framing, checked lengths, complete postcard consumption and dependency precondition validation before publication. Optional descriptors, duplicate/ambiguous region-code keys and unknown shared-code regions are checked without country allowlists; repeated non-geographic IDs on separate codes remain valid. core/src/dataset.rs rejects trailing bytes, duplicate groups and counts impossible for the supplied bytes, without an unmeasured numeric cap. datasets/src/bin/build-number-metadata.rs:11 converts vendored XML only at build time. core/Cargo.toml pins the phonenumber DTO version and adds postcard; datasets/Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock carry converter dependencies. Root Cargo.toml is unchanged.

Boundary/compatibility tests: core/tests/{ffi,number_metadata,ffi_memory,dataset}.rs; tools/test-ffi.sh; tools/ffi-tests/{SwiftHostSmoke.swift,KotlinHostSmoke.kt,KotlinHostSmokeTest.kt,build.gradle,settings.gradle,fixtures.rs,numbering.xml,numbering-v1.hex,README.md}. The nonempty frozen CFNM fixture guards wire-format drift. Fresh bindings are generated under ignored target/ffi-tests. Both foreign programs really execute normalization, geocoding/fallback/NotGeographic, rules/conflicts/unsigned IDs, explanation, caps, allow subtraction, snapshot mismatch, cancellation, declared/unexpected callback exceptions, reentry and concurrent evaluation; Swift additionally verifies callback release. The standalone offline JVM harness uses local Gradle's embedded Kotlin and JNA, not the Android app/SDK.

Verification: final cargo fmt --all -- --check; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings; cargo test --workspace --all-targets --locked (175 passed, 4 ignored); cargo test --workspace --doc --locked; both source/data checks; fresh Swift/Kotlin host gate; git diff --check all passed. The ignored host fixture writer and isolated release runtime measurement were executed separately. Existing distribution and real-data ignored suites were not rerun. Final log /tmp/caller-filter-p005-final.log; runtime log /tmp/caller-filter-p005-runtime.log; durable commands/contracts/measurements in tools/ffi-tests/README.md.

Measured release host runtime, not converter footprint: CFNM 526,596 bytes; cold parse 112.18 ms, peak Rust heap 4,153,627 bytes, retained 1,863,810; second database with old retained 96.07 ms, combined peak 6,017,437. Warm FFI streaming 1,000 vs 10,000 outputs at batch 32 peaked at 887 vs 888 bytes, compared with 197,576 when collecting. These are observations, not configured limits.

Remaining/unverified: real iOS/Android device execution, OS extension budgets, RSS/foreign heaps, OTA delivery (P007), and production app integration are outside this host slice. phonenumber's inherited compiled country enum still limits genuinely new region IDs; existing-region metadata updates are runtime-loadable, but this task does not claim brand-new geographic IDs work. Candidate budget applies per deny and preflight is not cancellable; shells must run expansion off the UI thread and stage delivered batches until success. Known non-failing tooling warnings: generated Kotlin has two unused expressions; release multi-crate-type test builds warn about Cargo output collisions. No required host verification remains.
tasks.notes:
Implementation approved and delegated to GPT-5.6 Luna, with parent independent review. User explicitly prohibits Graphify. Approved slice includes runtime numbering packaging (P007 OTA excluded), bounded synchronous callback FFI, host Swift/Kotlin tests and isolated memory/startup checks. Initial implementation exists in core/src/ffi.rs, number_metadata.rs, datasets/src/bin/build-number-metadata.rs, approved tests/tools. Parent rejected first pass: (1) generated ExpansionSink is Rust-only, so no usable foreign sink; (2) combined cap violated: exact denies 390212345678/679 with max_entries=1 returned Fits{entries:2} and delivered both; (3) snapshot fingerprint compares labels only, accepting changed same-version data, and explain lacks mismatch check; (4) Debug-string errors/verdicts lose structured contract, no conflict-pair/prefix/format access; (5) postcard internal trailing bytes accepted; (6) unmeasured 10M dataset limit; (7) memory test only checks zero batch, Kotlin not executed, Swift tests only empty Allow; runtime DB memory not separately measured. Exact repro /tmp/caller-filter-p005-review.rs ran against target/bindings/libcallerfilter_core.rlib. Worker fix pass 6948eb7f-a14a-419c-b91f-88218c8b47b2 owns all approved source writes. Asked to preserve existing public APIs/core algorithms, remove unauthorized root manifest additions (git status now confirms root Cargo.toml restored), add substantive both-language tests, strict payload checks and measurements. No commits/pushes. Task/P005 remain open pending parent re-review and requested validation.
Additional parent review after compaction: /tmp/caller-filter-p005-panic-review.rs independently confirmed two panics against first-pass library: missing national_number in a present descriptor panics at phonenumber metadata/database.rs:75 during NumberMetadata::parse; known hint region absent from loaded DB panics at parser/helper.rs:188 during FFI normalization. Worker notified to validate every descriptor and guard missing runtime regions with typed errors, testing partial datasets and +international hint handling. Upstream validator.rs:148-179 also uses compiled country::Id and can panic on unknown region IDs sharing a calling code; genuinely new region-ID support remains an inherited dependency constraint, not yet verified. Do not hard-code region lists or reject legitimate repeated non-geographic IDs across different calling codes. Existing expander/explain semantics reviewed without edits; no expander rewrite authorized.
